{{Otheruses|Captain}}
'''Flight Captain''' was a rank held by [[TIE pilot]] officers during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Within [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], Flight Captain was a rank used by the [[Starfighter Corps (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Starfighter Corps]]. It ranked above [[Flight Lieutenant]], and below [[Commander/Legends|Commander]]. The rank was the equivalent of [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Senior Lieutenant/Legends|Senior Lieutenant]] and [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

[[T. Alvak]] was promoted to the rank of flight captain after seeing action in the [[Solaest Uprising]] and earning a [[Distinguished Flight Medal/Legends|Distinguished Flight Medal]].
